records.footnote: Data on research and development (R&D) in Singapore are collected through the National Survey of Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE), conducted on an annual basis by the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR).  Industries are classified based on Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2020.
